title: Team
body: Everyone who works at {academy}, their roles and pending invitations.

invitations.heading: Pending invitations
invitations.emptyBody: Invite teachers and office staff by email. They choose their own password.
invitations.revokeBody: The link sent to {email} will stop working. You can invite them again later.

inviteSheet.title: Invite a team member
inviteSheet.body: We'll email a link to join {academy}. It expires in 7 days.
inviteSheet.rolesHint: Choose at least one. You can only give roles you hold yourself.

memberSheet.title: Manage {name}
memberSheet.rolesHint: Roles you can't give are shown but can't be changed.
memberSheet.disableBody: They'll be signed out of {academy} at once and can't sign in until you restore access. Nothing they did is deleted.

errors.alreadyMember: This person is already a member of {academy}.
errors.notGrantable: You can't give that role. Ask an owner.
errors.ownerOnly: Only an owner can change another owner.
errors.lastOwner: {academy} needs at least one active owner.
errors.versionConflict: Someone else changed this member a moment ago. The latest details are now shown — try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many invitations in a short time. Try again in a while.
errors.gone: This invitation is no longer pending.
errors.offline: You're offline. Team changes need a connection.
errors.generic: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.

permission.title: You can't view the team
permission.body: Ask an owner or admin of {academy} if you need access to the team.
